'''3637 BBY''' was the fifth [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Around that time, [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] became a contested resource between the two powers, and the [[Order of Revan]] manipulated both the Republic and the Empire into a campaign of mutual destruction that was halted at the [[Battle of Rishi]].

==Events==
*The [[Order of Revan]], previously believed to be a minor cult in the Empire, emerges as a major galaxy-wide threat, believed to be under the leadership of [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] himself. A coalition formed by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] and [[Darth Marr]] defeats Revan on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. In so doing, however, they awaken the former Sith Emperor, now known by his former Sith name of Vitiate.
